text: This staff report is in regards to a matter for which the North York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to consider an application submitted by the owner of 31 Holcolm Road to maintain a 2.4 meter high cedar hedge in the rear and flankage yards, which does not meet the requirements specified in City of Toronto Municipal Code, Chapter 447, Fences.

North York Community Council: 1. Granted the exemption for the property at 31 Holcolm Road to maintain an area of 1.2 metres by 1.2 metres in the rear and flankage yard, clear of any hedges, trees, or shrubs. 2. Directed that, at such time as replacement of the fence is required, the replacement fence will comply with Municipal Code Chapter 447, or its successor by-law.
